title: Finite reduction of adic completion
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a commutative Noetherian ring, $I=(f_1,\ldots,f_r)$ a finitely generated ideal, $P_n=\Lambda/I^n$ for $n\geq1$, and $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ satisfy [def-weil-pbc-complete-coefficient-datum]. Thus $\Lambda/I$ is additive torsion and every $P_n$ in degree zero is perfect over $\Lambda$. All coefficient sheaves in this statement are constant: write $\Lambda_X$ and $(P_n)_X$, and put $K_n=K\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}(P_n)_X$. Regard the reductions as $\Lambda_X$-objects by restriction of scalars. Compute their strict reduction tower using one K-flat representative of $K$ [def-weil-derived-tensor], and let $L=R\lim_n K_n$ be its total right derived inverse limit [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], with canonical evaluation $p_a:L\to K_a$.

For every $a\geq1$, the adjoint of $p_a$ under derived extension and restriction of scalars [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction, lem-pc-derived-adjoint-functors] is a functorial isomorphism in $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},P_a)$:
$$L\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}(P_a)_X\xrightarrow{\sim}K_a.$$
No derived completeness hypothesis on $K$ is imposed.

proof.text: Construct the canonical scalar Hom equivalence with its specified unit formula using lem-weil-pbc-adic-reduction-adjunction-hom-equiv. Define the finite-reduction map as the inverse image of evaluation under this equivalence. The restricted Koszul calculation is precisely lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-reduction-restricted. Exact scalar restriction reflects derived isomorphisms by lem-weil-pbc-adic-derived-restrict-conservative, so that restricted isomorphism proves adicCompletionReduction_isIso.

source.place: Proof step 6; steps 1–5 are isolated in the restricted Koszul-calculation node

proof.text: For functoriality, apply the canonical scalar Hom equivalence to the two composites. The strict reduction transitions are natural by adicTransitionComplex_naturality; the quotient-augmentation square follows from naturality of module sheafification. The defining projection equation for adicCompletionTowerMap gives evaluation naturality. Combine these squares with naturality of the exact restriction comparison and cancel by injectivity of the Hom equivalence. This proves the representative naturality formula without the remaining Koszul isomorphism theorem.

proof_origin.place: D4: composition of the three existing interfaces; scalar Hom equivalence now proved with no new holes. The restricted interface retains the Koszul proof steps 1–5.
